choice.basis: The chart (chart_1) shows the reservoir surface temperature at the start of the review period (2005) is 24.0°C and at the end of the review period (2015) is 10.0°C. This represents a full-period change of 14.0°C. A decrease of 14.0°C over a 10-year period is a significant shift in the physical state of the reservoir, clearly exceeding the bounds of 'ordinary variation' or routine monitoring. Therefore, the change requires substantial-change follow-up.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 reservoir surface temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
